one_line: Chalukya king who led disciplined campaigns into Kanchipuram and commemorated his victories at Pattadakal.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, athletic and broad-shouldered, with the steady bearing of an experienced field commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight sharp nose, neatly groomed medium moustache, faint trimmed beard along the jawline, and calm, focused eyes with a habitual composed, confident expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, neatly bound topknot (kudumi) at the back crown, sides smoothly drawn back, adorned with a simple gold circlet band around the forehead and a small central leaf-shaped ornament above the brow.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late 8th-century Deccan royal attire: a knee-length off‑white cotton angavastra-style wrapped tunic draped over both shoulders and belted at the waist, worn over a deep red silk dhoti tied in the Deccan style with neat front pleats and a back tuck falling to the ankles; a broad dark gold woven cloth belt with subtle geometric pattern cinches the waist, from which hangs a small dagger in a plain sheath; over his torso sits a fitted bronze-colored mail-and-plate corselet that covers chest and back but leaves the angavastra sleeves visible, with leather fastening straps at the sides; his forearms bear simple bronze bracers and his feet are in brown leather sandals with toe loops; jewellery is dignified but not ostentatious—paired gold karnapatra earrings, a single medium-width gold torque necklace, two slim gold armlets on the upper arms, and a crimson silk sash with a narrow gold border draped from left shoulder to right hip, evoking courtly yet campaign-ready dress.
appearance.signature: A long straight-edged steel sword with a slightly widening tip, fitted with a simple bronze crossguard and a dark wooden grip, sheathed in a plain dark brown scabbard with minimal gold fittings, carried at his left hip and often held upright with both hands in formal, controlled poses.

ref_desc: Vikramaditya II is a late-30s, medium-brown Deccan king with an oval face, trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet, wearing an off-white wrapped tunic, deep red dhoti, bronze corselet, gold jewellery, crimson sash, and carrying a long straight-edged steel sword in a dark brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Vikramaditya II as a dignified 8th-century Chalukya king: late 30s, medium-brown Deccan complexion, oval face with strong jaw, straight nose, neatly trimmed medium moustache and faint beard along the jawline, calm focused eyes and a composed, confident expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a high, neatly bound topknot at the back crown, sides smooth, with a simple gold circlet around his forehead and a small leaf-shaped ornament centered above the brow. He wears an era-accurate late Badami Chalukya campaign outfit: a knee-length off‑white cotton angavastra-style wrapped tunic covering his torso and upper arms, belted, over a deep red silk dhoti tied in Deccan style with neat front pleats and back tuck reaching the ankles. Over his torso is a fitted bronze-colored mail-and-plate corselet that covers chest and back, with leather side straps, leaving the light fabric at his shoulders and arms visible. A broad dark gold woven cloth belt with subtle geometric pattern cinches his waist, from which hangs a small dagger; a crimson silk sash with a narrow gold border runs from left shoulder to right hip. His forearms have simple bronze bracers, upper arms bear slim gold armlets, he wears a single medium-width gold torque necklace and gold karnapatra earrings, and his feet are in brown leather sandals with toe loops. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a long straight-edged steel sword with slightly widening tip, simple bronze crossguard and dark wooden grip, in a plain dark brown scabbard with minimal gold fittings; show him in a neutral, balanced stance holding the sheathed sword upright in one view and relaxed at his side in another, clearly displaying the deep red, off-white, bronze, gold and dark brown colour palette.
